donors.reason: BET bromodomain inhibitor; chromatin reader perturbation can alter histone-mark profiles.
Quinazoline piperidine; no retrieved evidence of histone perturbation, only structural description.
Indolecarboxamide; retrieved source lacks mechanism or histone-mark evidence.
Benzamide N-acylpiperidine; retrieved source lacks chromatin or histone-mark mechanism.
GSK3/tau kinase inhibitor; indirect signaling-to-chromatin candidate, not direct histone modifier.

revised_hypotheses: EX527 anchor profile is dominated by H3K27me1K36me3 and related H3K27/K36 methylation marks, so chromatin-reader or epigenetic-modifier donors are more plausible transfer sources than kinase or immunomodulatory donors.
Among retrieved donors, GSK525762A has the clearest chromatin pharmacology via BET bromodomain inhibition, but it is not a direct H3K27/K36 methyltransferase or demethylase modulator.
BIX-01294 was not retrieved in this round, so its prior high anchor similarity cannot be cited as source-supported evidence.
CHIR99021 may indirectly perturb chromatin through GSK3 signaling, but retrieved evidence only supports kinase inhibition, not histone-mark remodeling.
CPI-169, UNC1215, and other candidate donors lack retrieved mechanism text here, so their support remains unresolved.
unresolved: No retrieved donor source directly links EX527 to histone H3K27/K36 methylation changes in A375.
No retrieved source provides measured histone-mark response values for any donor.
BIX-01294, CPI-169, and UNC1215 mechanism descriptions were not supplied in retrieved_sources.
The PubChem EX527 description confirms only chemical class, not epigenetic mechanism.
